column1: # The answers to the mutants no behavioural test kills (VARKA-265): dev/varka_pit_verdicts.py
# reads them into the verdicts report. One line per mutant, tab-separated: the class, the method,
# its descriptor, the mutator and the instruction indexes - PIT's identity of the mutant, as the
# report's run gives it - then its line, for the reader, then the test that now kills it or why it
# changes no behaviour. A note matching no mutant of a method the run mutated fails the report.

column7: equivalent: planWordAlgebra, which runs first, skips every Cond node, so pureWord holds none and the next line's null check skips a Cond root as this one does
